text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian Deputy Prime Minister Jane Miljovski to attend the Dublin meeting of European finance ministers on Wednesday.
- European parliament delegation meets Macedonian president Kiro Gligorov and other officials in Skopje. An EU mission will be opened in Skopje.
- The Macedonian World War Two veterans' organisation extends support to the ruling party candidate for Skopje mayor Jovica Ugrinovski. -- Skopje newsroom, 389 91 201 196
